correctness.rationale: Write M_i=sI+tX_i with X_i off-diagonal. Any odd X-product has zero trace; pair terms at t² are permutation independent. The sole schedule-dependent trace term is t⁴ product(c_i)(r_pi1 r_pi3+r_pi2 r_pi4). Three distinct alternating-position partitions occur eight times each and strictly order by products of positive ratio differences. The determinant of the product is product(s²−t² b_i c_i), independent of schedule. For a strictly positive 2x2 product Perron eigenvalue is strictly increasing in trace at fixed determinant, even if determinant is negative. Each matrix product increases entrywise with t>0, so each Perron root increases continuously from s^4<1 to infinity; distinct classes cross 1 at strictly separated unique t. For <=3 factors no ordering-dependent even X-product of length four exists. Independently reproduced all 24 rational schedule products, trace classes, determinant, and opposite invasion outcomes in the supplied numeric example.
